paragraph: When preparing a recipe, 1 US cup of water is approximately 300 mL, while 2 tablespoons equal 30 mL and 1 teaspoon equals 5 mL. If an oven is set to 350°F, the equivalent temperature is approximately 177°C. For a smaller recipe, 500 mL of milk is equivalent to approximately 2.11 US cups.

When planning a road trip, converting kilometres into miles can help estimate travel distances. A journey of 5 km is approximately 4.0 miles, while 12 km is approximately 7.46 miles. If a driver travels at 100 km/h, their speed is equivalent to approximately 62.14 mph. A 250 km trip would take 2.5 hours at an average speed of 100 km/h.

Understanding temperature conversions is useful when comparing weather forecasts from different countries. A temperature of 20°C is equivalent to 80°F, while 0°C corresponds to 32°F. On a particularly warm day, 30°C is equivalent to 86°F. Water freezes at approximately 0°C and boils at approximately 100°C under standard atmospheric pressure.

Speed conversions are especially useful when driving in countries that use different measurement systems. A vehicle travelling at 60 mph is moving at approximately 120 km/h. Similarly, 90 km/h is equivalent to approximately 55.92 mph. A speed of 1 m/s corresponds to 3.6 km/h, which is useful when studying walking and running speeds.

Body weight is commonly measured in kilograms in Canada and pounds in the United States. A person weighing 70 kg has a weight of approximately 190 lb, while someone weighing 5 kg is equivalent to approximately 11.02 lb. Conversely, a weight of 150 lb corresponds to approximately 68.04 kg. These conversions are helpful when comparing measurements from different fitness devices.

Calculating room area is important when purchasing flooring or planning furniture arrangements. A room measuring 12 ft by 10 ft has an area of 120 square feet, which is approximately 15 m². For comparison, 1 m² is equivalent to approximately 10.764 square feet. A larger room measuring 15 ft by 20 ft would have an area of 300 square feet.

Room volume can be calculated by multiplying its length, width, and height. A room measuring 2 m long, 3 m wide, and 2.5 m high has a volume of 20 m³. Since 1 m³ equals 1,000 litres, this room has a volume equivalent to 15,000 litres. A container holding 500 litres has a volume of 0.5 m³.

Cooking measurements frequently require converting between metric and imperial units. A measuring jug containing 250 mL of liquid holds approximately 1.5 US cups. Similarly, 1 litre is equivalent to approximately 4.23 US cups, and 15 mL equals 1 tablespoon. For a large recipe, 2 litres of water would provide approximately 8.45 US cups.

Temperature and distance conversions are useful when travelling internationally. A weather forecast showing 68°F indicates a temperature of approximately 25°C. If a destination is located 2.5 miles away, the distance is approximately 4.02 km. A longer journey of 10 miles corresponds to approximately 16.09 km, which can help travellers estimate transportation distances.

Everyday measurements often involve converting body weight, room dimensions, and liquid volumes. A person weighing 180 lb has a body weight of approximately 100 kg. Meanwhile, a room measuring 2.4 m by 3 m has a floor area of 7.2 m². A bottle containing 750 mL of water holds 0.75 litres, while 3 litres is equivalent to 3,000 mL.
